title: Effects of Six Types of Exercise Interventions on Inhibitory Control, Executive Function, and Gross Motor Skills in Children With ADHD: A Network Meta-Analysis of 26 Randomized Controlled Trials.

answer.design_quote: We conducted the NMA using Stata 15.0 software (StataCorp LLC, College Station, TX, USA), treating all outcomes as continuous variables.
answer.k_quote: We systematically searched six databases, including PubMed, Web of Science, China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), Embase, Scopus, and SPORT Discus (EBSCOhost), to screen 26 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) covering 1,276 children with ADHD.
